effects.description: The recipient cannot move, but can still use Combo Attacks, Active and Ultimate Skills, and Invoke their Titan.The Chain debuff is removed if the recipient Invokes a Titan.

effects.label: DEF Down
effects.description: Decreases the recipient's Defense stat by the indicated percentage.

effects.label: Hex
effects.description: If killed while under this debuff, the recipient of the debuff cannot be Revived.

effects.label: Weaken
effects.description: Increase the damage the recipient takes from all attacks by the indicated percentage.

levels.text:
Attacks 10 enemies in a 8.5m radius around Shadek, dealing 144 damage. Casts a [Hex] debuff on the targets, lasting 10s. If a target dies while under a [Hex] debuff, it gains [Block Revive], preventing revival. Then, casts a [15% Weaken] debuff on the targets, lasting 10s, increasing all damage taken by 15%.

bio: For all his life, Shadek followed the Path of Light, and was held up by the Lightseekers as a paragon of purity – until a single moment changed him forever. Forged in light, twisted by darkness, Shadek still walks the same path – but now in shadows.
